initialExam.title: Haryana Judicial Services 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Civil Judges (Junior Division) in Haryana Judicial Service through competitive examination conducted by the Punjab & Haryana High Court.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB from recognized university + enrolled advocate (3 years practice)
initialExam.qualifications: LLB degree + Advocate enrollment with Bar Council + 3 years practice
initialExam.syllabus: Civil Law (CPC, Indian Contract Act, Transfer of Property Act, Specific Relief Act, Limitation Act, Partnership Act, Hindu Law, Muslim Law), Criminal Law (IPC, CrPC, Indian Evidence Act, Prevention of Corruption Act, NDPS Act, SC/ST Atrocities Act), Constitutional Law (Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Writs, Emergency, Centre-State Relations, Panchayati Raj), Haryana Local Laws (Haryana Urban Control of Rent & Eviction Act, East Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, Haryana Panchayati Raj Act, Punjab Land Revenue Act), Language & GK (English, Hindi, General Knowledge of India & Haryana).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims (Objective): Civil + Criminal + Constitutional Law + GK - 200 marks, 120 min. Mains: Paper I (Civil Law) 200 marks, Paper II (Criminal Law) 200 marks, Paper III (English + Hindi + GK) 200 marks - 180 min each. Viva Voce (Interview).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination → Mains Examination → Viva Voce (Interview) → Document Verification → Medical Examination

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years, BC-A/B: 5 years, PwD: 10 years, Ex-Servicemen: as per Haryana Govt rules

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, Official Residence, Conveyance Allowance, Book Allowance, Robe Allowance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge JD → Civil Judge SD → Additional District & Sessions Judge → District & Sessions Judge → High Court Judge.
initialExam.jobRole: Presiding over civil and criminal matters in Haryana subordinate courts. Conducting trials, hearing arguments, and delivering judgments.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit highcourtchd.gov.in or sssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
